description: Reviewed Enyo NNUE improvement-run config. Search-aware preflight: existing-weight Enyo net, broad labels plus multi-move search targets.
goal: Test whether search-aware child-margin/policy supervision can move exported representation without broad scalar collapse. This is a preflight, not a promotion candidate.

required_after_training: validate.py net-diff against init net; exported input/L1 movement must be intentional and not zero unless trainable config says so
static validation on broad packed data must not show a clear sign regression
search-gate against assets/failure_suite/search_aware_targets_20260523.jsonl must improve capped gap without mate-like tail collapse
failure-suite replay must not introduce a tail worse than the current gate thresholds
validation.sprt_rule: No SPRT unless net-diff/static/search-gate/failure-suite gates are all clean. This preflight is expected to be diagnostic.
